programme.title: Medījums pret plēsēju
programme.desc: Plašā, necaurejamā mežā sākas pakaļdzīšanās spēle, kurā uzvarēt var tikai viens. Dalībnieki ir sadalīti divās grupās - Medījumā un Plēsējos, taču lomas nav nemainīgas. Kamēr vieni cenšas nosargāt savu naudas balvu un izvairīties no vajātājiem, otri dodas medībās, lai viņus atrastu un ieņemtu viņu vietu. Ar modernu izsekošanas tehnoloģiju palīdzību neviens nevar noslēpties uz ilgu laiku, tāpēc drošības sajūta ir tikai ilūzija. Cīņā par izdzīvošanu svarīga kļūst ne tikai izturība un orientēšanās spējas, bet arī viltība, stratēģija un prasme izvēlēties īstos sabiedrotos. Ikviens nepareizs lēmums var maksāt vietu spēlē, bet uzvarētāju gaida iespaidīga naudas balva.

programme.title: Lauku sēta
programme.desc: Lauku sētas trešā darba nedēļa dalībniekiem sola pamatīgu izaicinājumu! Viņiem jāiztīra saimnieces vecmāmiņas vistu kūts, kur bez vistu saimes un gaiļiem mīt arī divas kazas. Taču ar to viss nebeidzas, jo jāuzceļ arī augsts žogs, lai kūts iemītnieki nevarētu brīvi klīst pa visu teritoriju. Par darbu vadītāju ieceļ jūrmalnieci Ilzi. Vai pilsētniecei šis būs pa spēkam? Lustīgā noskaņojumā visi ķeras pie darba. Taču ilgi nav jāgaida, līdz uzvirmo pirmās nesaskaņas, jo dalībnieku viedokļi par to, kā vislabāk tikt galā ar nezālēm, krasi atšķiras. Un arī šoreiz Ieva savus padomus nepatur pie sevis, arvien vairāk kaitinot pārējos. Kristeram un arī citiem dalībniekiem rodas arvien vairāk iebildumu pret darba vadītājas Ilzes veikumu, jo trūkst nepieciešamo instrumentu un darbu sadale nevedas tik raiti, kā cerēts. Kristers Ilzi pat nodēvē par princesīti, taču Ilze uzskata, ka darba vadītājai galvenais ir komandēt, nevis pašai strādāt. Mēslu smaka daudziem dalībniekiem, īpaši dāmām, izrādās īsts pārbaudījums. Ievai no kūts aromāta pat kļūst slikti. Taču šie nepatīkamie aromāti nav vienīgais, kas liek saraukt degunu. Pie pusdienu galda uzvirmo diskusijas par higiēnu un tiek apspriests arī apavu nepatīkamais aromāts. Kamēr aktīvi tiek apspriests, kuram kājas ož visvairāk, nakts aizsegā atkal pastrādāts nedarbs. Kāds sasējis apavus kopā un sakarinājis pie virtuves. Par šādu joku pamatīgi sadusmojas Arnita, kura šonedēļ saimnieko virtuvē. Viņa apņemas atrast vainīgo un pusdienās pasniegt knapu maltīti. Par grēkāzi tiek izraudzīta Megija, kura to uztver ļoti sāpīgi. Jaunā māmiņa nespēj valdīt emocijas un izplūst asarās. Kā jau 13. sezonā pienākas, negaidīti pavērsieni ik uz soļa! Dalībniekiem tiek dota iespēja savu balsi izbalsošanā iemainīt pret noslēpumaino iespēju ripu, kurā var slēpties gan vērtīgs ieguvums, gan pilnīga vilšanās. Veiklākā izrādās Laura, un viņa, apmaiņā pret savu balsi, tiek pie iespējas ieiet karstā dušā.

programme.title: Nevainīgā
programme.desc: Jaunā Cecīlija (Sidnija Svīnija) pamet savus dzimtos Amerikas laukus, lai nodotos ticībai kā mūķene slavenā itāļu klosterī. Taču, neskatoties uz silto uzņemšanu, Cecīlija drīz vien atskārst, ka viņas jaunās mājas glabā drūmus un šausminošus noslēpumus.

programme.title: Grieķijas brīvdienas
programme.desc: No rīta Elita ar Igoru paziņo, ka vakarā gaidāms pikniks ar visām no tā izrietošajām sekām - virtuves elektrotehnika nav pieejama, ēdieni jāservē brīvdabas apstākļos un žūrijai jābauda maltīte pavisam askētiskos apstākļos. Pirmo reizi komandām neveicas viktorīnā - abi pretinieki nopelna pavisam nelielu summu. Apņēmīgie pavāri gan cer, ka naudas trūkumu varēs kompensēt ar makšķernieka veiksmi, jo grilēšanai nepieciešamā zivs viņiem pašiem jānoķer. Pirms doties uz piknika vietu, ar nelielu zvejas kuģīti visi dodas jūrā ķert zivis.

programme.title: Grieķijas brīvdienas
programme.desc: Astoņi dalībnieki no Latvijas dodas saulaini kulinārā ceļojumā uz Grieķiju, lai sacenstos par labākā pavāra titulu. Katru dienu viņi komandās gatavo ēdienus vietējo iedzīvotāju žūrijai, un zaudētājiem ir jāšķiras no kāda dalībnieka. Spriedzi vairos negaidīti pavērsieni - komandu maiņas, izbalsoto atgriešanās un gatavošana visdažādākajos apstākļos. Ceļojumā cauri Grieķijas garšām dalībniekus ved ekstravagantā Elita Patmalniece un šarmantais Igors Popovs.

programme.title: Grieķijas brīvdienas
programme.desc: Trīs Latvijas pavāri ir pavisam tuvu galvenajai balvai - katram no viņiem ir reālas iespējas uzvarēt, bet kurš tas būs? Jokus virtuvē nomainījis saspringts klusums. Ar pretiniekiem konsultēties nevar, bet nav arī komandas, pie kuras vērsties pēc padoma. Ēdiena vērtētāji ir stingri, un šoreiz pamanītas tiek ne tikai garšas nianses, bet arī tas, cik veiksmīgi katrs no pavāriem apkalpo žūriju pie galda. Pēc maltītes gan esošie, gan izbalsotie dalībbnieki dodas pastaigā pa Krētas galvaspilsētu Irakliju, taču vismaz trīs pusfinālistu sejas liecina, ka pilsēta viņus maz interesē - galvenie notikumi šodien risināsies izbalsošanā.

programme.title: Pasaule no augšas
programme.desc: Elpu aizraujoši kadri ļauj no putna lidojuma iepazīt dažādus pasaules reģionus, pilsētvidi un dabas ainavas visā to krāšņumā. Unikālā perspektīva paver iespēju detalizēti aplūkot varenus dabas pieminekļus un arhitektoniskās īpatnības, kā arī unikālu kultūras mantojumu, kas no zemes līmeņa bieži paliek nepamanīts.

programme.title: Sporta momenti
programme.desc: Dokumentālās sērijas aplūko aizraujošos stāstus, ko atklāj slavenākās fotogrāfijas sporta vēsturē. Iemūžinātie mirkļi ataino spilgtākos divdesmitā gadsimta atlētus, kā arī ilustrē svarīgus momentus, kas mainījuši sporta vēstures gaitu.

programme.title: Death on the Nile
programme.desc: During a luxurious pleasure cruise down the Nile aboard a lavish vessel populated with wealthy passengers, widely despised heiress and home wrecker Linnet Ridgeway is murdered. Also aboard is famed Belgian detective Poirot and his taciturn traveling companion, Colonel Race. Poirot undertakes an investigation into Ridgeway's killing, but as more bodies pile up, it appears that nearly everyone aboard has a motive.

programme.title: Amanda
programme.desc: Mikhaël Hers's quietly sensitive drama follows the life of a young man who takes on the responsibility of raising his seven-year-old niece Amanda, after his sister is killed in a terrorist attack on Paris. Starring Vincent Lacoste and Isaure Multrier. David Sorel (Lacoste) is your average uncle. He picks up his niece Amanda (Multrier) from school, but arrives a little late. He's happy to discuss the order in which he eats food with Amanda, bad first or last? He gets on well with his sister, Sandrine (Ophélia Kolb), except when he's late to pick up Amanda from school. But they all get on well enough to plan a trip to London for Wimbledon centre court tickets. And Amanda says that, once they get there, she would like to visit 'mummy's mummy'. David got a letter from their mum, Alison (Greta Scacchi) too, but he is less forgiving of her 20-year absence. So far, we could be forgiven for thinking that generational family healing is the thrust of this quietly domesticated drama. But then David cycles through Paris to meet Sandrine, a ride that echoes one we have already seen them enjoy together, when he is passed by two motorbikes and a van. One of the motorbikes pulls a wheelie. David watches the vehicles pass. When he arrives at the park where he's due to meet Sandrine, the scene looks familiar - people with picnic baskets enjoying a sunny afternoon. But then we notice there is blood. Someone is trying to drag someone else away from the scene, but they are deadweight. There has been a mass shooting and Sandrine is one of the victims. Suddenly, not only does David have to break the news to his young niece that her mother is dead, he must become her guardian. How will they cope? And should they still take the trip to London? In French, with English subtitles. Network Premiere.

programme.title: Unfinished Affairs
programme.desc: Inspector Manuel Bianquetti is forced to accept a transfer to a police precinct in Cádiz. His initially peaceful move will soon be shattered with the discovery of the body of a young girl who reminds him of a terrible past. Despite the opposition of his superiors, Bianquetti will embark on a solo crusade to find the culprit, following clues that might be no more than figments of his imagination. The only person who seems to be on his side is his neighbour, a fragile nurse harassed by her former partner.

programme.title: Days of the Bagnold Summer
programme.desc: Coming-of-age comedy starring Earl Cave (son of singer Nick) as a heavy-metal-loving teenager who is forced to spend the summer with his boring old mum, in Simon Bird's (The Inbetweeners) debut feature in the director's chair. Daniel (Cave) is all set for six weeks in Florida with his dad and his dad's pregnant wife, Bernie. The weather will be fantastic, and he'll get to drive his father's MG convertible. Meanwhile, his mum (Monica Dolan) won't let him drive the Vauxhall Astra and she never gets her own cake, but instead nicks bits of his. So, when Bernie calls to say that Daniel won't be able to come to Florida, Daniel is obviously not very happy. Can a Metallica-loving, black-clad teenager with Tippexed emblems on his shoes have any fun with a middle-aged librarian who wears comfortable sandals? Well, she is his mum... Also starring Tamsin Greig and Rob Brydon. Network Premiere.

programme.title: Mr. Morgan's Last Love
programme.desc: Michael Caine and Clémence Poésy star in writer-director Sandra Nettlebeck's romantic comedy-drama. Retired philosophy professor Matthew Morgan (Caine) is a non-French-speaking American living in Paris. Recently widowed, he's attempting to come to terms with the loss of his much-loved wife (Jane Alexander), with whom he has fantasy chats. One day, he meets lonely young dance teacher Pauline (Poesy) on a bus, where she helps him out of an awkward situation. It's the start of a relaxed but close friendship that rekindles his dormant interest in life. She teaches him the cha-cha and he talks to her about the great thinkers of philosophy. But his sadness about his bereavement overwhelms him and he attempts to kill himself. Morgan's estranged children, Miles (Justin Kirk) and Karen (Gillian Anderson), turn up from America. They're both worried and angry about their father and his new friendship, not least because they believe Pauline might be a gold-digger. Network premiere.

programme.title: Girl with a Pearl Earring
programme.desc: Screen adaptation of Tracy Chevalier's best-selling novel, inspired by the Johannes Vermeer painting of the same name. Set in mid-17th-century Delft, Holland, 17-year-old Griet is forced into servanthood when her father suffers an accident and becomes unable to work. She is taken on at the Vermeer household, where her presence immediately provokes hostility from members of the family - particularly the artist's wife and eldest daughter - when she starts to forge an understanding with her mysterious master.

programme.title: The Wait
programme.desc: Amidst the large rooms of an old villa marked by time, Anna, emerging from a sudden bereavement, spends her days in solitude. The rugged and beautiful Sicilian countryside surrounds the house and isolates her while the fog, which is slowly climbing the slopes of Mount Etna, prevents the eye seeing any distance. Only the footsteps of Pietro, the handyman, break the silence. And all of a sudden Jeanne appears, a young woman who claims to be the girlfriend of Giuseppe, Anna's son. He invited her to Sicily to spend a few days' holiday together. Anna was unaware of Jeanne's existence. And Giuseppe is not there. But his things are all there, in his room. Soon, very soon he will return, is what Anna says, unable to reveal a truth that for her cannot be spoken. The days pass, the two women slowly get to know each other, and together they begin to wait for Easter, when Giuseppe will finally come home, and a great traditional procession will be held in the village.

programme.title: My Friend from the Park
programme.desc: Liz, a new mother, meets Rosa and they end up becoming good friends. However, their friendship takes an unexpected turn as Liz is pulled into a life of crime and instability.

programme.title: Bright Star
programme.desc: Drama based on the doomed love affair between Romantic poet John Keats and the young Fanny Brawne. On the outskirts of 19th-century London, John Keats struggles through grinding poverty and constant ill-health to establish himself as a writer, while the young seamstress Fanny Brawne is intrigued by her secretive neighbour and is determined to seek him out. The two begin a blissful three-year romance of lazy summers and slow burning love, until Keats' protective friend Charles Brown grows wary of Brawne. However, this soon proves to be the least of their problems when Keats' health starts to fail badly, beginning the end of the magical love affair.

programme.title: Lucky Break
programme.desc: Director Peter Cattaneo followed up his success in The Full Monty with this prison-based comedy drama. James Nesbitt plays Jimmy Hands, an inept robber determined to escape prison under the cover of governor Graham Mortimer's (Christopher Plummer) self-penned musical about Nelson (which Stephen Fry wrote especially for the film). Even within the prison walls, there's a chance for romance with visiting psychiatrist Annabel Sweep (Olivia Williams). But can Jimmy, together with Roger, Rudy and Cliff (Bill Nighy, Lennie James and Timothy Spall), join her on the outside?

programme.title: In Our Prime
programme.desc: When an outcast in a private school meets the school's security guard and asks him to teach him maths, their friendship is put at risk after an incident there.

programme.title: Is Anybody There?
programme.desc: Bittersweet tale of an unusual friendship, starring Michael Caine as retired magician Clarence. Edward hates living in the old people's home run by his parents. His only interest is an obsession with ghosts, death and the afterlife. Until, that is, the arrival of reluctant new resident, Clarence - a retired magician with a liberating streak of anarchy. Together the odd couple overcome their personal drawbacks.

programme.title: Outbound
programme.desc: A drama about a woman who seems able to overcome everything for freedom, except for her past mistakes.

programme.title: The Safe House
programme.desc: An eccentric family portrait set during the May 1968 protests in Paris. A nine-year-old boy stays with his grandparents and uncles while his parents protest. When an illustrious guest seeks refuge in the apartment, the family's dynamics change.

programme.title: The Graduate
programme.desc: Classic Oscar-winning comedy drama. Disillusioned graduate Benjamin Braddock is urged by his family to enter a business career and settle down after college, but instead he finds himself seduced by Mrs Robinson, a friend of his parents. He tries to extricate himself from the affair when he falls in love with Mrs Robinson's daughter, but finds that his own actions may have sealed his fate. Featuring the music of Simon and Garfunkel.

programme.title: Nezouh
programme.desc: Even as bombs fall on Damascus, Mutaz refuses to flee to the uncertain life of a refugee. His wife, Hala, and daughter, Zeina, must make the choice whether to stay or leave.

programme.title: The Wicker Man
programme.desc: Edward Woodward, Christopher Lee, Britt Ekland and Diane Cilento star in Robin Hardy's classic horror. Strait-laced police sergeant and devout Christian Neil Howie (Woodward) is sent to the remote Hebridean island of Summerisle to investigate the disappearance of a young girl called Rowan (Gerry Cowper). But his investigations and his morals are disturbed by the behaviour of the islanders, especially their free sexuality and their worship of the pagan gods. He meets the island's leader, Lord Summerisle (Lee), who explains how his Victorian grandfather developed fruit trees that thrived on the island and on which the islanders have come to depend. But with May Day approaching, Howie unearths what he thinks is a sinister connection between Rowan's disappearance and Lord Summerisle's orchards. And this places him in extreme peril. With Britt Ekland as Willow, the innkeeper's daughter; and Diane Cilento as the school teacher. Shown here in the "Final Cut" version of the movie. First play on Film4 (previously seen on Channel 4).

programme.title: Synecdoche, New York
programme.desc: Theater director Caden Cotard is mounting a new play. Fresh off of a successful production of Death of a Salesman, he has traded in the suburban blue-hairs and regional theater of Schenectady for the cultured audiences and bright footlights of Broadway. Armed with a MacArthur grant and determined to create a piece of brutal realism and honesty, something into which he can put his whole self, he gathers an ensemble cast into a warehouse in Manhattan's theater district. He directs them in a celebration of the mundane, instructing each to live out their constructed lives in a small mock-up of the city outside. As the city inside the warehouse grows, Caden's own life veers wildly off the tracks. The shadow of his ex-wife Adele, a celebrated painter who left him years ago for Germany's art scene, sneers at him from every corner. Somewhere in Berlin, his daughter Olive is growing up under the questionable guidance of Adele's friend, Maria. He's helplessly driving his marriage to actress ...

programme.title: The Magic of Belle Isle
programme.desc: Monte Wildhorn (Freeman) is a famous Western (genre) novelist. His struggle to cope with the death of his wife six years earlier has sapped his passion for writing and has caused him to begin drinking heavily. He takes a lakeside cabin for the summer in picturesque Belle Isle and befriends the family next door—an attractive single mother (Madsen) and her young daughters—who help him find inspiration again.

programme.title: Sol
programme.desc: Sol, a famous Argentine Tango performer, has lived in Buenos Aires for many years. Behind her excessive temper and her glowing smile, the Diva hides an injury from which she never really recovered: the loss of her only son, Raphaël.

programme.title: The Iron Lady
programme.desc: Meryl Streep won both a Best Actress Bafta and Oscar in the titular role of director Phyllida's biopic of the former Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher, who died recently. Writer Abi Morgan's script follows Thatcher's rise from modest beginnings to her role as Prime Minister, framed by a contemporary imagining of her later years, largely spent outside public scrutiny. The octogenarian Thatcher (Streep) is prompted to reminisce about her life and rise to power, as well as recalling her closest relationships, in particular that with her now-deceased husband Denis (Jim Broadbent). The young Margaret's (Alexandra Roach) ascendance in politics, inspired by her father, begins in the late 40s and takes her to the landmark moment in British history when she leads the Conservative Party to victory in the General Election of 1979, becoming the country's first female Prime Minister. Significant moments in recent history follow - from the Falklands War to the Miner's Strike and the Brighton Grand Hotel bombing - until finally, in 1990, she resigns and leaves 10 Downing Street. While it's impossible to completely eschew Thatcher's politics in a film of this nature - and politicians past and present had much to say on the film's portrait of the PM - the dramatisation is predominantly focused on the story of a woman who smashed gender and class barriers in a male-dominated world; and is ultimately an intimate portrait of an extraordinary and complex woman. Also starring Olivia Colman (as Carol Thatcher), Harry Lloyd (as a young Denis), Anthony Head (as Geoffrey Howe), Richard E Grant (as Michael Heseltine) and Roger Allam (as Gordon Reece). A Film4 co-production.

programme.title: Nostalgia
programme.desc: A man returns to his hometown of Naples, 40 years after abruptly leaving as a teen, stirring up a past which he's kept buried. He is determined to see his boyhood friend, now a leading Naples crime boss, with whom he shares a dark secret. Italian with English subtitles

programme.title: Millions
programme.desc: The Hoopstars travel to Michigan for a tournament. They get off to a terrible start in their first game, trailing 18-2 at one point. They come back to take the lead with a minute remaining, but wind up losing. They lose the second game of the day on a three-pointer at the buzzer, and also drop a third contest. Coach Douglas remains positive after the first loss, but gradually grows more disappointed with their effort. Many of the girls admit to being distracted. A frustrated Maria avoids her teammates at the hotel that night because it doesn't seem they are taking the losses very seriously. The Hoopstars win their final game of the tournament, but still worry about how they will fare at State.

programme.title: The Decoy Bride
programme.desc: Famous actress Lara Tyler can't get married to author James Arber without intrusive paparazzi crashing the ceremony. Because of James's best-seller, Lara's agent, Steve, checks out the little known Hegg Island in Scotland as the site for their next attempted wedding. Unfortunately, James is a hack, and his book (supposedly based on Hegg) relays little of it accurately. Katie, an island native and the only unmarried woman on it, has been unlucky in love. She's working on writing her own guide to Hegg Island when Steve and crew arrive, eventually hiring her as a reluctant decoy bride to distract the paparazzi. In a mix-up, she and James end up married to each other while Lara, having spotted the press, goes into hiding. Katie and James now have to get an island divorce while avoiding the press while other parties seek out Lara (who has disguised herself as one of the elderly islanders).

programme.title: Flash Gordon
programme.desc: Mike Hodges' film is a gloriously kitsch update of the 1930s comic strip and film series, starring Sam J Jones as the American football star Flash Gordon, who's transported, along with the beautiful Dale Arden (Melody Anderson), by Dr Zarkov (Topol) into the realm of the most evil ruler in the universe, the Emperor Ming (Max von Sydow). Only by uniting those under Ming's merciless rule to join his revolution can Flash save Earth from destruction. The unashamedly over-the-top Queen soundtrack is matched by Danilo Donati's effervescent production design, and the film also stars Brian Blessed as the chief of the Hawkmen, Timothy Dalton as the leader of the Treemen, and Ornella Muti as Ming's daughter, whose lascivious designs on Flash are just one of the challenges he must overcome if he's to end Ming's tyranny.

programme.title: Last Days in the Desert
programme.desc: Drama ''Last Days in the Desert'' follows Jesus in an imagined chapter from his 40 days of fasting and praying in the desert. On his way out of the wilderness, he struggles with Satan over the fate of an ordinary family in crisis, setting for himself a dramatic test with distinctly human conflicts.

programme.title: The Iron Lady
programme.desc: Meryl Streep won both a Best Actress Bafta and Oscar in the titular role of director Phyllida's biopic of the former Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher, who died recently. Writer Abi Morgan's script follows Thatcher's rise from modest beginnings to her role as Prime Minister, framed by a contemporary imagining of her later years, largely spent outside public scrutiny. The octogenarian Thatcher (Streep) is prompted to reminisce about her life and rise to power, as well as recalling her closest relationships, in particular that with her now-deceased husband Denis (Jim Broadbent). The young Margaret's (Alexandra Roach) ascendance in politics, inspired by her father, begins in the late 40s and takes her to the landmark moment in British history when she leads the Conservative Party to victory in the General Election of 1979, becoming the country's first female Prime Minister. Significant moments in recent history follow - from the Falklands War to the Miner's Strike and the Brighton Grand Hotel bombing - until finally, in 1990, she resigns and leaves 10 Downing Street. While it's impossible to completely eschew Thatcher's politics in a film of this nature - and politicians past and present had much to say on the film's portrait of the PM - the dramatisation is predominantly focused on the story of a woman who smashed gender and class barriers in a male-dominated world; and is ultimately an intimate portrait of an extraordinary and complex woman. Also starring Olivia Colman (as Carol Thatcher), Harry Lloyd (as a young Denis), Anthony Head (as Geoffrey Howe), Richard E Grant (as Michael Heseltine) and Roger Allam (as Gordon Reece). A Film4 co-production.

programme.title: Samia: Little Dreamer
programme.desc: Follows an assertive young woman as she fights to become an Olympic athlete.

programme.title: The Ladykillers
programme.desc: The last of the great Ealing comedies. Despite a distinguished cast including Alec Guinness, Peter Sellers, Jack Warner and Herbert Lom, it is Katie Johnson who steals the show as the little old lady who innocently takes in a criminal gang believing them to be a string quintet. When she discovers that they have just robbed a bank and insists that they give themselves up to the police, the gang decide that Mrs Wilberforce must die - but none of them can steel themselves to kill her. Frankie Howerd also has a cameo role as a barrow boy.

programme.title: Asako I & II
programme.desc: Asako lives in Osaka. She falls in love with Baku, a free-spirit. One day, Baku suddenly disappears. Two years later, Asako now lives in Tokyo and meets Ryohei. He looks just like Baku, but has a completely different personality.

programme.title: Murder on the Orient Express
programme.desc: Hercue Poirot is travelling aboard the Orient Express from Istanbul to Paris. During the journey, Poirot is approached by American businessman Ratchett, who unsuccessfully tries to hire the detective to expose the source of the death threats being made against him. The next night the train is caught in heavy Balkan snow, and the following morning Ratchett is found stabbed to death. Railway executive Bianchi prevails upon Poirot to solve the case, and with the train fully booked, there are no shortage of suspects.

programme.title: Iris
programme.desc: When the young Iris Murdoch meets fellow student John Bayley at Somerville College, Oxford, he is a naive virgin easily flummoxed by her libertine spirit, arch personality, and obvious artistic talent. Decades later, little has changed and the couple keeps house, with John doting on his more famous wife. When Iris begins experiencing forgetfulness and dementia, however, the devoted John struggles with hopelessness and frustration, and becomes her caretaker, as his wife's mind deteriorates from the ravages of Alzheimer's disease.

programme.title: Главное
programme.desc: Ежедневная информационная программа.

programme.title: Лицом к событию
programme.desc: Лидер в той или иной сфере общественной жизни - человек известный и информированный - под перекрестным огнем вопросов ведущих программы Михаила Соколова и Елены Рыковцевой.

programme.title: Крым.Реалии
programme.desc: Три года назад Афанасьевка в Николаевской области стала островом. После подрыва дамбы Каховской ГЭС большая вода сначала прошла мимо села, но позже вернулась. Приток Днепра Ингулец наполнил озера, окружающие Афанасьевку, и отрезал населенный пункт от остальной части области. В воде оказалось 75 домов, жертв в удалось избежать. Люди до сих пор приходят в себя после большого наводнения 2023 года. Многим не хватает денег завершить ремонт в собственных домах или купить новую мебель, так как прежняя утонула. Сколько времени Афанасьевка была островом? Почему люди не верили, что вода дойдет до них? И как уже три года восстанавливают дома, поврежденные водой?

programme.title: Перекресток
programme.desc: Несмотря на войну, Одесса продолжает жить в своем ритме. На рассвете у моря собираются десятки людей — послушать живую музыку и хотя бы ненадолго отвлечься от тревог. На "Привозе" торгуют морепродуктами, туристы фотографируются с легендарной Тетей Соней, а пляжи снова принимают отдыхающих. Но воздушные тревоги здесь давно стали частью повседневности. Люди возвращаются к морю после отбоя, а вечером на Дерибасовской звучит музыка. В Аркадии работают клубы и аттракционы — город пытается отдыхать, даже когда совсем рядом звучат взрывы. В то же время всего в нескольких десятках километров от Одессы — совсем другая картина. Полупустые пляжи, закрытые отели и заминированное море. Некогда популярный черноморский курорт в Николаевской области — Коблево — все больше напоминает прифронтовую зону. Доступ к морю ограничен из-за минной опасности, курортная инфраструктура пустеет, а местный бизнес пытается выжить в условиях войны. Как сегодня живет Одесса между сиренами, музыкой и морем? Почему одни туристы продолжают отдыхать на побережье, а другие рискуют жизнью, пытаясь попасть к закрытому морю в Коблево? И как война изменила два популярных украинских курорта — смотрите в выпуске.

programme.title: Глобал
programme.desc: Тележурнал об экологии, возможностях и рисках глобализации. Мы живем в глобальном мире, где, например, климатические изменения тропических лесов Амазонки оказывают влияние на жизнь в Европе. Программа предоставляет дайджесты новейших исследований по вопросам глобализации и экологии, ищет решение для глобальных последствий локальных действий - и наоборот, рассказывает о положительном опыте и примерах в сфере экологии, аграрной или промышленной деятельности других стран.

programme.title: Опасное соседство
programme.desc: Шпицберген - самая северная часть Европы, расположенная всего в 1000 км от Северного полюса. Здесь, за полярным кругом, находится настоящий российский посёлок Баренцбург, который отличается от других подобных населённых пунктов тем, что расположен на территории, входящей в состав Евросоюза. В Баренцбурге живут россияне, украинцы, таджики, создавая уникальное соседство для соседних норвежских поселений

programme.title: Ждём в гости
programme.desc: Финляндия — настоящий оазис тишины и покоя, где люди и природа живут в полной гармонии. Здесь, вдали от крупных мегаполисов, кажется, что даже время замедляет ход, а воздух наполнен ароматами леса и свежестью озер. Программа приглашает зрителей в небольшой, но очень колоритный городок Кангасниеми, расположенный у живописного озера Пуула. Ведущий Зураб Двали познакомит не только с местными красотами, но и с замечательными людьми, которые бережно хранят традиции и идут в ногу со временем, уделяя большое внимание развитию туризма в крае.
